rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline with one coherent export-aligned change: keep `attn.c_v.weight` in fp16 for recurrent tail blocks and bias quant-aware roundtrip mixing toward tail value/projection tensors while reducing pressure on earlier blocks. This targets the strongest remaining local signal around recurrent-tail float rescue and value-path export sensitivity without changing evaluation, data paths, or wallclock behavior.
title: Tail Value-Path Quant-Aware Export Focus
